exposure: Information received in antenatal education regarding common birth interventions and complications
outcome: Mismatch between birth expectations and experience
cohort: Postnatal women (< 12 months postpartum) aged >= 16 who had received antenatal care at a single NHS Trust.
finding: Women's expectations of birth, informed by antenatal education, can lead to a mismatch between expectations and experience, negatively impacting postnatal psychological wellbeing.
mod_finding: Antenatal education was perceived to present a 'hierarchy of birth' where vaginal birth with minimal pain relief and limited intervention was considered 'better'.
